validation.visual_checks: Viewed all four generated originals. Each has exactly 16 body labels, 16 matching neck strips, distinctive colors and motifs, readable generic category titles; no bottle artwork or directional lighting. Mechanical crops preserve the full body artwork and regularize cell positions.

source_counts.planned_distribution: 48 main-room bottles + 10 cocktail standing bottles + 6 inverted optic bottles; this is a fuller reconstruction, not an exact source census
